summary: Software Engineer with 1+ year of hands-on experience in designing and developing scalable, high-performance web applications using modern technologies including React, Node.js, JavaScript, and Java. Proficient in building full-stack solutions with cloud-based backends such as Supabase and Neon, and experienced in deploying production-ready applications using GitHub and Vercel with seamless API integrations.

experiences.desc: Developed scalable full-stack web applications using React, Node.js, JavaScript, and Java technologies. Built a Company Expense Tracker with AI image recognition automating receipt data extraction. Designed and developed 'Ready to Collab' platform enabling seamless influencer and brand collaboration. Delivered over 50 responsive portfolio websites with optimized UI/UX and performance. Integrated RESTful APIs and third-party services ensuring secure, efficient, scalable data handling systems. Utilized Supabase and Neon PostgreSQL for backend services with optimized database structures efficiently. Managed version control and deployments using GitHub and Vercel establishing smooth CI/CD workflows. Collaborated across the development lifecycle, delivering production-ready solutions.

projects.title: Company Expense Tracker Tool
projects.description: Developed a role-based Company Expense Tracker with separate dashboards for efficient expense management. Built using React and Node.js with Supabase for database, authentication, and secure storage. Implemented Supabase Storage to manage receipt uploads and integrated AI chat for expense insights. Designed dynamic dashboards and optimized large-scale data fetching using Redis caching. Leveraged CDN and scalable architecture for low-latency, high-performance, real-time expense tracking.

projects.title: Big Career Dream
projects.description: Developed a large-scale job platform aggregating U.S. job listings by scraping multiple job portals. Processed and fetched lakhs of records efficiently using optimized queries and high-performance database handling. Handled massive API traffic by distributing requests across servers for scalability and reliability. Supported high concurrent users with robust architecture ensuring seamless performance under heavy loads. Integrated AI for resume parsing and an intelligent chatbot for enhanced user interaction and insights.

projects.title: Ready To Collab
projects.description: Developed 'Ready to Collab,' a full-stack platform enabling brand – influencer discovery, matching, and campaign management. Built using React, Node.js, and REST APIs with scalable backend architecture and optimized database queries. Implemented real-time communication, email integrations, and content-sharing workflows for seamless collaboration.
